rationale: The stock has already gapped up 11.2% on strong earnings and is sitting at 90.8% of today's range near the session high, with price consolidating in a tight band around $164.93–$165.32 after an initial surge. The wide bid-ask spread (43.6 bps) and the fact that the gap has already been largely absorbed reduce the edge on a long entry, while the stock's position near the high and strong fundamental catalyst make a short equally unattractive. With no clear directional momentum signal and elevated slippage risk, the risk/reward does not justify a new position at this moment.
